itemdesc-smokelesspowder: Nitrocellulose powder. Far stronger than black powder and leaves no smoke trail. Used to load metallic cartridges.
itemdesc-guncotton: Nitrated plant fibre. Soak in spirits in a sealed barrel to gelatinise it into smokeless powder.
itemdesc-casing: Empty brass case for a .30-30 cartridge.
itemdesc-shotguncasing: Empty brass casing for a shotgun shell.
itemdesc-shotshell-buckshot: Smokeless shotgun shell loaded with lead buckshot pellets.
itemdesc-shotshell-slug: Smokeless shotgun shell loaded with a lead slug.
itemdesc-primer: Percussion primer cup for metallic cartridges.
itemdesc-cartridge-*: Brass-cased .30-30 round loaded with smokeless powder. Fired from the lever-action carbine.
itemdesc-leveraction-carbine:
Side-loading, lever-action repeating carbine (6 in the tube + 1 chambered).

Only reload when empty: hold right mouse to load through the side gate, then hold again to chamber a round and aim. Firing works the lever automatically.

Hold 'Alt' to interact instead of aim/reload.
itemdesc-shotgun-single:
Single-barrel break-action shotgun for buckshot or slug shells. Reload only when empty.

Hold right mouse to open the breech and load, then use right mouse to ready and aim.
itemdesc-shotgun-double:
Double-barrel break-action shotgun holding two shells. Reload only when both barrels are empty.

Hold right mouse to open the breech and load each shell, then use right mouse to ready and aim.
itemdesc-rollingblock: Single-shot, rear-loading rolling-block rifle in .50 calibre. Extremely accurate at long range. Reload when empty.
itemdesc-heavycartridge-50: Heavy .50 calibre rifle cartridge. Hits very hard.
itemdesc-gunsmithblueprints: Reference plans required to assemble a firearm's firing mechanism. Reusable crafting tool.
itemdesc-triggersear: Precision-cut trigger and sear parts for a firearm mechanism.
itemdesc-firingpin: Hardened firing pin for a firearm mechanism.
itemdesc-mainspring: Heavy spring for a firearm mechanism.
itemdesc-leveractionmechanism: Unique receiver and lockwork assembly for the lever-action carbine.
itemdesc-shotgunmechanism: Unique lockwork assembly for break-action shotguns.
itemdesc-rollingblockmechanism: Unique breech and lockwork assembly for the rolling-block rifle.
itemdesc-ak47: Full-auto AK-47 with a 30-round detachable magazine. Reload when empty; the spent magazine is returned.
